mechanism: Selegiline (MAOI at higher doses) combined with nalmefene (opioid antagonist with monoamine reuptake inhibition properties) creates risk of serotonin syndrome and unpredictable CNS effects; nalmefene may also interfere with selegiline's therapeutic mechanism.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use lowest selegiline dose with careful monitoring for serotonergic symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, muscle rigidity) and CNS depression.
